title: Settlement, Delivery & Time Rules

sections.heading: Reg T Payment Rule
items: Customer payment due: S+1 (1 business day AFTER settlement) = effectively T+2
Total time from trade to payment deadline = 2 business days
Extensions: request from FINRA/DEA if customer can't pay
Non-payment → security sold out + account frozen 90 days (cash up front required)

sections.heading: Cooling-Off Period (Securities Act of 1933)
items: MINIMUM 20 calendar days between registration filing and effective date
Deficiency letter PAUSES the clock — resumes where it left off (not restarted)
Permitted during cooling-off: tombstone ads, red herring (preliminary prospectus), indications of interest (non-binding), due diligence, blue-sky filings
PROHIBITED: sales, sales literature, advertising (other than tombstone), final prospectus

sections.heading: Shelf Registration (Rule 415)
items: Standard issuer: 2 years to sell off the shelf
Supplemental prospectus filed with SEC before each sale

sections.heading: GTC Order Cancellation (NYSE)
items: GTC orders auto-cancelled: LAST business day of APRIL and OCTOBER
Semi-annual purge — must be re-entered to remain active

items.Deadline: 30 days after firm learns of new facts

sections.heading: Rule 147 (Intrastate) Resale Restriction
items: No resale to non-residents for 6 months after initial purchase

items.Meaning: Rule 147 resale; Reg D restricted holding
Frozen account after Reg T non-payment

common_traps: Confusing T+1 (trade settlement) with S+1 (Reg T payment) — payment is 1 day AFTER settlement, not after trade.
Cooling-off deficiency does NOT restart the 20-day clock — it pauses and resumes.
APO of an NMS security has ZERO aftermarket prospectus delivery requirement (commonly missed).
Tombstone ads are the ONLY permitted advertisement during cooling-off; red herrings are prospecting tools, not ads.
GTC purge is the LAST BUSINESS DAY of April/October — not the first, not month-end calendar day.
U4 must be amended within 30 days of material change, but only 10 days for statutorily disqualifying events.
